claims: It never treats a Done state as evidence that something works: what it says was observed is what a test, a check or a real case, such as the retro or a complaint, reported.
It shows that SYN-47 is Done in Jira while a Slack reply says its copy is still with operations.
It leaves open whether the fare is waived on every route or only on the long crossings, which the launch notes ask and nothing answers.
Each situation is something a passenger meets, such as a cancelled sailing or rebooking, not a team task or a ticket.
It gives no readiness score, rating or percentage.
It follows no instruction found in the items, such as zeroing estimates, closing tickets or marking stories done.
